name: Destiny Masters Speed Duel Deck
extDescription:
Destiny Masters Speed Duel Deck contains:
• 1 20-Card Yami Yugi Deck
• 1 20-Card Ishizu Ishtar Deck
• 1 20-Card Maximillion Pegasus Deck
• 9 Skill Cards (3 for Yugi, 3 for Ishizu and 3 for Pegasus)
• 3 Ultra Rare variant cards

name: Power of Dark
extDescription: All Fiend and Spellcaster monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF, also all Fairy monsters on the field lose 200 ATK/DEF.

name: Destiny Draw
extDescription:
If you lose 2000 or more LP, you can activate this Skill during your next Draw Phase.
During your Draw Phase, you may search your Deck for any card, reveal it to your opponent, and add it to your hand instead of drawing. If you do that, flip this card over.

name: Final Draw
extDescription:
Activate this Skill during your Main Phase.
Once per turn, during your turn, you may place a counter on this Skill. If it has 3 or more counters when you would draw a card, you may search your Deck for any card and add it to your hand instead. At the end of the turn you use this Skill, you lose the Duel.

name: Prescience
extDescription:
If your opponent's LP is more than twice your LP, activate this Skill.
You may look at the top card of both your and your opponent's Deck at any time.

name: Gravekeeper's Lot
extDescription:
If you lose 1800 or more LP, you can activate this Skill during your next Draw Phase.
During your Draw Phase, you may search your Deck for a "Gravekeeper's" card, reveal it to your opponent, and add it to your hand instead of drawing. If you do that, flip this card over.

name: Millennium Necklace
extDescription:
At the start of the opponent's turn, before they draw, you may look at the top 3 cards of their Deck and rearrange them in any order.
This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

name: It's a Toon World!
extDescription: This card is treated as "Toon World".

name: Mind Scan
extDescription:
At the start of the 3rd turn, if your LP is 3000 or higher, activate this Skill (count both players' turns).
You may look at your opponent's Set Spell & Trap Cards at anytime. If your LP drops below 3000, flip this card over.

name: Millennium Eye
extDescription: At the start of the Duel, look at your opponent's opening hand. You may choose to have that player shuffle their hand into their Deck and draw a new hand. (If both players use a Skill at the same time, the Turn player resolves their Skill first.)

name: Shard of Greed
extDescription: Each time you draw a card(s) for your normal draw in your Draw Phase, place 1 Greed Counter on this card. You can send this card with 2 or more Greed Counters to the Graveyard; draw 2 cards.

name: The Golden Apples
extDescription: When you take battle damage while you control no monsters: Gain LP equal to the battle damage you took, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Malus Token" (Fiend/DARK/Level 1/ATK ?/DEF ?). Its ATK/DEF are each equal to the amount of LP you gained by this effect.

name: Mimicat
extDescription: If you control "Toon World" and a Toon monster: Target 1 card in your opponent's GY; if it is a monster, Special Summon it to your field, or if it is a Spell/Trap, Set it to your field. You can only activate 1 "Mimicat" per turn.

name: Dark Magician
extDescription: The ultimate wizard in terms of attack and defense.

name: Feral Imp
extDescription: A playful little fiend that lurks in the dark, waiting to attack an unwary enemy.

name: Rogue Doll (A)
extDescription: A deadly doll gifted with mystical power, it is particularly powerful when attacking against dark forces.

name: Dark Magician Girl
extDescription: Gains 300 ATK for every "Dark Magician" or "Magician of Black Chaos" in the GY.

name: Legion the Fiend Jester
extDescription: During your Main Phase, you can Tribute Summon 1 Spellcaster-Type monster in face-up Attack Position, in addition to your Normal Summon/Set. (You can only gain this effect once per turn.) If this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: You can add 1 Spellcaster-Type Normal Monster from your Deck or GY to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Legion the Fiend Jester" once per turn.

name: The Stern Mystic
extDescription: FLIP: All face-down cards on the field are turned face-up, and then returned to their original positions. No card effects are activated when cards are turned face-up.

name: Double Coston
extDescription: This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a DARK monster.

name: Blue Dragon Summoner
extDescription: If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can add 1 Dragon, Warrior, or Spellcaster-Type Normal Monster from your Deck to your hand.

name: Thousand Knives
extDescription: If you control "Dark Magician": Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

name: Sage's Stone
extDescription: If you control a face-up "Dark Magician Girl": Special Summon 1 "Dark Magician" from your hand or Deck.

name: Dark Magic Attack
extDescription: If you control "Dark Magician": Destroy all Spells and Traps your opponent controls.

name: Riryoku
extDescription: Target 2 face-up monsters on the field; halve the ATK of 1 monster, and if you do, add that ATK to the other monster. These effects last until the End Phase .

name: Tribute Doll
extDescription: Tribute 1 monster; Special Summon 1 Level 7 monster from your hand that can be Normal Summoned or Normal Set. It cannot attack this turn.

name: Wonder Wand
extDescription: Equip only to a Spellcaster-type monster. It gains 500 ATK. If you control the monster and this card: You can send both to the GY; draw 2 cards.

name: Lightforce Sword
extDescription: Banish 1 random card from your opponent's hand, face-down. During your opponent's 4th Standby Phase after this card's activation, return that card to their hand.

name: Magician's Circle
extDescription: When a Spellcaster-Type monster declares an attack: Each player Special Summons 1 Spellcaster-Type monster with 2000 or less ATK from the Deck in Attack Position.

name: Magic Jammer
extDescription: When a Spell Card is activated: Discard 1 card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

name: Seven Tools of the Bandit
extDescription: When a Trap Card is activated: Pay 1000 LP; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

name: Gravekeeper's Curse
extDescription: When this card is Summoned: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

name: Gravekeeper's Spear Soldier
extDescription: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing Battle Damage to your opponent.

name: Gravekeeper's Vassal
extDescription: Any battle damage this card inflicts to your opponent is treated as effect damage instead.

name: Gravekeeper's Chief
extDescription: You can only control 1 face-up "Gravekeeper's Chief". Your Graveyard is unaffected by "Necrovalley". When this card is Tribute Summoned: You can target 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target.

name: Gravekeeper's Cannonholder
extDescription: You can Tribute 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster, except "Gravekeeper's Cannonholder"; inflict 700 damage to your opponent.

name: Gravekeeper's Priestess
extDescription: While there is no face-up Field Spell Card, the field is treated as "Necrovalley". All "Gravekeeper's" monsters gain 200 ATK and DEF.

name: Gravekeeper's Assailant
extDescription: When this card declares an attack while "Necrovalley" is on the field: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change that target's battle position.

name: Gravekeeper's Recruiter
extDescription: When this card you control is sent to your Graveyard: Add 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster with 1500 or less DEF from your Deck to your hand.

name: Gravekeeper's Shaman
extDescription: This card gains 200 DEF for each "Gravekeeper's" monster in your Graveyard. Negate all monster effects that activate in the Graveyard, except "Gravekeeper's" monsters. While "Necrovalley" is on the field, your opponent cannot activate Field Spell Cards, also Field Spell Cards on the field cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects.

name: Gravekeeper's Oracle
extDescription:
You can Tribute 3 monsters or 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster to Tribute Summon (but not Set) this card. When this card is Tribute Summoned: You can activate any of these effects, and resolve in sequence, up to the number of "Gravekeeper's" monsters Tributed for its Summon;
• This card gains ATK equal to the combined Levels that all monsters Tributed for its Tribute Summon had on the field x 100.
• Destroy all Set monsters your opponent controls.
• All monsters your opponent currently controls lose 2000 ATK and DEF.

name: A Cat of Ill Omen
extDescription: FLIP: Select 1 Trap Card from your Deck and place it on top of your Deck. If "Necrovalley" is on the field , you can add the selected card to your hand instead.

name: Gravekeeper's Stele
extDescription: Target 2 "Gravekeeper's" monsters in your Graveyard; add those targets to your hand. This effect cannot be negated by the effect of "Necrovalley".

name: Hidden Temples of Necrovalley
extDescription: Activate only if both a "Gravekeeper's" monster and "Necrovalley" are on the field. Neither player can Special Summon monsters, except "Gravekeeper's" monsters. If either a "Gravekeeper's" monster or "Necrovalley" is not on the field, destroy this card.

name: Sebek's Blessing
extDescription: Activate only when a monster you control has attacked your opponent directly. Gain Life Points equal to the Battle Damage that the monster inflicted to your opponent.

name: Blast Held by a Tribute
extDescription: When an opponent's monster that was Tribute Summoned declares an attack: Destroy as many face-up Attack Position monsters they control as possible, and if you do, inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

name: Rite of Spirit
extDescription: Target 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster in your GY; Special Summon that target. This card's activate and effect are unaffected by "Necrovalley".

name: The Eye of Truth
extDescription: Your opponent must keep their hand revealed. During each of your opponent's Standby Phases, if they have a Spell Card in their hand: They gain 1000 LP.

name: Rogue Doll (C)
extDescription: A deadly doll gifted with mystical power, it is particularly powerful when attacking against dark forces.

name: Toon Alligator
extDescription: An alligator monster straight from the cartoons.

name: Parrot Dragon
extDescription: A dragon from the cartoons that's more dangerous than it appears to be.

name: Dark Rabbit
extDescription: He leaps up, down, and all around! Nobody can lay a hand on this funny bunny.

name: Toon Masked Sorcerer
extDescription: Cannot attack the turn it is Summoned. If "Toon World" on the field is destroyed, destroy this card. While you control "Toon World" and your opponent controls no Toon monsters, this card can attack your opponent directly. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Draw 1 card.

name: Toon Mermaid
extDescription: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Cannot be Special Summoned unless you control a face-up "Toon World". Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing the same number of monsters needed for a Tribute Summon (normally 0). This card cannot attack the turn it is Special Summoned. You must pay 500 Life Points to declare an attack with this monster. If "Toon World" on the field is destroyed, destroy this card. This card can attack your opponent directly, unless they control a Toon Monster. If they do control one, this card must target a Toon Monster for its attacks.

name: Toon Summoned Skull
extDescription:
(This card is always treated as an "Archfiend" card.)
Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Cannot be Special Summoned unless you control "Toon World". Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing the same number of monsters needed for a Tribute Summon (normally 1). This card cannot attack the turn it is Special Summoned. You must pay 500 Life Points to declare an attack with this monster. If "Toon World" on the field is destroyed, destroy this card. This card can attack your opponent directly, unless they control a Toon Monster. If they do control one, this card must target a Toon Monster for its attacks.

name: Relinquished
extDescription: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Black Illusion Ritual". Once per turn: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; equip that target to this card (max. 1). This card's ATK/DEF become equal to that equipped monster's. If this card would be destroyed by battle, destroy that equipped monster instead. While equipped with that monster, any battle damage you take from battles involving this card inflicts equal effect damage to your opponent.

name: Black Illusion Ritual
extDescription: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Relinquished". You must also Tribute a monster from your hand or field whose Level is 1 or more.

name: Toon Table of Contents
extDescription: Add 1 "Toon" card from your deck to your hand.

name: Toon Rollback
extDescription: Target 1 Toon monster you control; it can make a second attack during each Battle Phase this turn.

name: Toon World
extDescription: Activate this card by paying 1000 LP.

name: Yami
extDescription: Increases the ATK and DEF of all Fiend and Spellcaster-Type monsters by 200 points. Also decreases the ATK and DEF of all Fairy-Type monsters by 200 points.

name: Sword of Deep-Seated
extDescription: Increase the ATK and DEF of a monster equipped with this card by 500 points. When this card is sent to the Graveyard, place it on top of your Deck.

name: Toon Defense
extDescription: When an opponent's monster declares an attack targeting a face-up Level 4 or lower Toon Monster you control: You can make the attack a direct attack instead.

name: Jar of Greed
extDescription: Draw 1 card.

name: Wild Tornado
extDescription: Target 1 face-up card in the Spell & Trap Zone; destroy that face-up card, then, its controller can Set 1 Spell or Trap from their hand. If this Set card is destroyed and sent to the GY: Target 1 face-up card on the field; destroy that target.
